notice: This is a sensitive directory of support services. If you or someone you know needs support, confidential assistance is available below.

categories.title: QUB Specific Resources
categories.description: Support services provided specifically for Queen's University Belfast students and staff.

items.name: QUB Report and Support
items.description: Online reporting tool and support network for students and staff experiencing bullying, harassment, sexual misconduct, or hate crime.
items.contact: Online reporting or direct email to Student Wellbeing

items.name: Inspire Counselling 24hr Helpline
items.description: Free, confidential 24/7 student counselling support line for all Queen's University students.

items.name: QUB Survivors
items.description: Student-run survivor solidarity network at Queen's University Belfast providing community and resources.
items.contact: Instagram direct message and resource links

categories.title: Mental Health Resources
categories.description: Dedicated mental wellbeing guidance and professional advice.

items.name: Mind UK
items.description: Advice, information, and support for anyone experiencing a mental health problem, with guides on trauma and recovery.

categories.title: LGBTQI+ Resources
categories.description: Specialized community care, advocacy, and safe spaces for LGBTQI+ individuals.

items.name: Transgender NI
items.description: Human rights and community organization dedicated to advocating for trans individuals in Northern Ireland.
items.contact: Advocacy, peer support and community information

items.name: Here NI (Lesbian & Bi Women)
items.description: Community organization dedicated to supporting lesbian and bisexual women and their families across Northern Ireland.
items.contact: Support group, casework and social events

categories.title: Resources for Women
categories.description: Advocacy networks and gender parity community initiatives across Northern Ireland.

items.name: Northern Ireland Rural Women's Network (NIRWN)
items.description: Supporting, connecting, and advocating for women living in rural communities across Northern Ireland.
items.contact: Regional network coordination and community projects

items.name: 50:50 NI
items.description: Campaigning for equal representation of women in Northern Ireland politics and public life.

items.name: The Belfast Girl Gang
items.description: Inclusive social and mutual-aid community group for women and non-binary individuals in Belfast.

categories.title: Rape and Sexual Assault Help Resources
categories.description: Specialist medical, legal, emotional, and counseling services for survivors of sexual violence.

items.name: Confidential Emotional Support Line (UK)
items.description: Confidential helpline offering emotional support for those who have experienced sexual assault, abuse, or violence.

items.name: The Rowan - Sexual Assault Referral Centre (NI)
items.description: Regional referral centre providing confidential 24/7 medical care, support, and advocacy for anyone who has experienced sexual violence in Northern Ireland.

items.name: Nexus NI
items.description: Specialist counseling and support services for survivors of sexual trauma and domestic violence across Northern Ireland.

items.name: Mind UK - Sexual Abuse Support
items.description: Guides to understanding trauma, rights, and therapeutic support services following abuse.

items.name: NI Direct - Domestic and Sexual Abuse Helpline
items.description: Official Northern Ireland government portal providing 24-hour telephone, email, and live text support.

items.name: Raise Your Voice
items.description: Grassroots organization tackling sexual harassment and sexual violence across Northern Ireland through advocacy and survivor workshops.

items.name: Rape Crisis NI
items.description: Independent crisis support, counseling, and helpline services for survivors across Northern Ireland.

items.name: CRASAC
items.description: Specialist counseling and support, including dedicated services for LGBTQI+ individuals affected by sexual violence.

categories.title: Domestic Violence Support
categories.description: Immediate safety planning, refuge accommodation, and community support.

items.name: Women's Aid Belfast and Lisburn (NI)
items.description: Providing safety, confidential support, emergency refuge accommodation, and outreach for women and children affected by domestic violence.

footerNotice: This list is not complete; if you have any suggestions or corrections, please let us know at thegraticule@outlook.com.
